discovery.result: NoypiGeeks reported the local 3 GB / 64 GB model available through TECNO's official Shopee store for PHP 4,990 on August 12, 2021; historical only.
YugaTech independently reported Philippine availability and the same PHP 4,990 price for the 3 GB / 64 GB configuration on August 13, 2021.
The current PinoyTechGuide TECNO price index was checked; it omits the base Spark 7. This is not evidence that no second-hand/private sale exists.
GSMArena global partner prices are not used as Philippine live offers and may refer to other variants or markets.

prices.excerpt: NoypiGeeks reported TECNO Spark 7 3 GB / 64 GB available in the Philippines for PHP 4,990 via TECNO's official Shopee store.
